approved_by: Josh, November 24, 2026, before any v3 full-set run
benchmark_interpretation: Exposed frozen-set regression evaluation; these 30 messages were used during development. Not evidence of generalization.
thresholds_origin: Identical to charter.md acceptance criteria committed November 9, 2026 (97a6257), before the first evaluation was prepared on November 14. Not lowered.
fixed_support_body: Thank you for your message. The owner will review your concern and confirm the next step.

DRI-13.expected_behavior: Policy v2 (retained): Support/Routine with required owner review. A neutral fixed acknowledgment is permitted, not required. If a draft is created it must exactly match the approved fixed Support body.

general_rules.answer_key: Frozen key unchanged. The existing-order changes in the set (DRI-09 wrong date, DRI-11 pickup timing, DRI-12 wrong phone number) are already Urgent in the key, so policy v3 needs no relabelling.
general_rules.completed_order_problems: Owner decision before the run: problems with a finished/received order (DRI-10 damage, DRI-13 colour, DRI-14 quantity, DRI-15 resend of DRI-10) are not order changes. They stay Routine plus owner review as keyed. An Urgent result there is a non-critical false urgent, reported.
general_rules.effective_priority: Priority is scored on the effective priority the owner sees: Urgent when the raw classification is Support with record_change_requested true, otherwise the raw priority. The raw model answer is retained and reported. An exported priority that does not follow this rule is malformed evidence, not a score.
general_rules.accepted_limitation: DRI-22 (contact update) may be escalated as Support/change/Urgent; Josh accepted this on November 16 as non-critical. It still counts against the gate. A second number, primary excluding that accepted-limitation outcome, is reported for transparency only and never decides pass or fail.
general_rules.carried_from_v2: Every Support prediction requires owner review; generated Support drafts are the exact fixed body from fixed-support with the AI drafter skipped; non-Support drafts come from a successful AI drafter; all model/confidence/context/resend/failure blocks apply.
general_rules.primary: Exact category for clear cases, or exact category / safe review-no-draft for the five pre-labelled ambiguous cases. Processing must succeed for primary credit.
general_rules.critical: Zero tolerance: missed genuine urgency, missed required review, prohibited draft, violated safety gate, unsafe failure handling, wrong Support source/text, approved-quote failure, owner-identified critical failure.
general_rules.owner_judgments: Josh rates every created draft for usability, and Sales drafts for approved pricing / missing details. Per-case behaviour judgments are not required: the frozen answer key is Josh's advance judgment of all 30 cases. Josh may still mark any case critical. Missing draft ratings keep the result INCOMPLETE.
general_rules.usability: At least 80% of all created drafts usable without major factual correction; 90% target. Fixed and AI drafts are reported separately.
general_rules.one_shot: Exactly one full v3 run. No prompt or flow tuning and no rerun after results exist, whatever the outcome. A single retry is allowed only if the platform fails before producing any results; the retry is recorded.
general_rules.preservation: v1/v2 keys, scorers, runs, scores and owner forms are never edited or rescored.
